Maya (AE): Hydrangea wants a 3-week POC to onboard a community adapter + bandwidth-optimized KV cache; asking for pricing at 200-300 QPS.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): Hosted first? Dedicated later for PHI?
Maya (AE): Yes. They plan to pin a quantized variant: `hydra-open-13b-q4f16`.
Lee (Infra): 13B q4 ~16-20GB mem. Sustained 250 QPS with low tails needs Dedicated or high cache hit.
Sam (Sales Eng): Can we give a rough cost for hosted vs dedicated?
Lee (Infra): With assumptions: 250 QPS, 8k ctx, 70% cache hit, avg 256 tokens -> ~48 GPU hours/day; recommend 3-4 A100-equivalent for reliable latency.
ops-bot: compute-estimate: estimated_gpu_hours_per_day=48; recommended_pool=4xA100-equivalent
Jordan (Solutions Eng): We support fallback routing to smaller variants. Community variants require verification/security scan before hosted onboarding.
Sam (Sales Eng): Action items for customer: security pack, model artifact + checksum, sample prompts, KMS requirements.
Maya (AE): Jordan/Lee please produce a one-page sizing + onboarding checklist by EOD tomorrow. I'll send action items to the customer. :thumbsup:
